elements.requirement: Section 77E applies where a person offers, or proposes to offer, goods for sale through an online marketplace.
elements.quote: offers, or proposes to offer, goods for sale through an online marketplace

elements.requirement: The operator of an online marketplace must take reasonable steps to check that any number provided to the operator by the seller or another person as that seller's VAT registration number is valid.
elements.quote: take reasonable steps to check that— (a) any number provided to the operator (by P or another person) as P's VAT registration number is valid

elements.requirement: The operator of an online marketplace must take reasonable steps to check that any number displayed on the online marketplace as the seller's VAT registration number is valid.
elements.quote: take reasonable steps to check that— (b) any number displayed on the online marketplace as P's VAT registration number (under subsection (3) or otherwise) is valid

elements.requirement: If a number provided to the operator as a seller's VAT registration number is valid, the operator must secure that it is displayed on the online marketplace as that seller's VAT registration number no later than the statutory deadline.
elements.quote: the operator must secure that it is displayed on the online marketplace as P's VAT registration number no later than the time mentioned in subsection (4)

elements.requirement: The deadline for displaying a valid VAT registration number is the end of the period of 10 days beginning with the day on which the operator is provided with the number.
elements.quote: the end of the period of 10 days beginning with the day on which the operator is provided with the number

elements.requirement: If a valid VAT registration number is provided before the seller offers goods for sale through the online marketplace, the deadline to display it is the later of the end of the 10-day period after provision and the end of the day on which the seller first offers goods for sale through the online marketplace.
elements.quote: if the number is provided before P offers goods for sale through the online marketplace, the later of— (i) the end of the period in paragraph (a), and (ii) the end of the day on which P first offers goods for sale through the online marketplace

elements.requirement: If the operator of an online marketplace becomes aware that a number displayed on the online marketplace as a seller's VAT registration number is not valid, the operator must secure that it is removed from the online marketplace before the end of the relevant period.
elements.quote: the operator must secure that it is removed from the online marketplace before the end of the relevant period

elements.requirement: The relevant period for removing an invalid displayed number is the period of 10 days beginning with the day on which the operator first became aware that the number was not valid.
elements.quote: The relevant period is the period of 10 days beginning with the day on which the operator first became aware that the number was not valid

elements.requirement: A number is treated as provided or displayed as a seller's VAT registration number only if it is provided or displayed in connection with the seller offering, or proposing to offer, goods for sale through the online marketplace.
elements.quote: only if it is provided or displayed in connection with P offering, or proposing to offer, goods for sale through the online marketplace

elements.requirement: A number provided or displayed as a seller's VAT registration number is valid only if the seller is registered under the Value Added Tax Act 1994 and the number is the seller's VAT registration number.
elements.quote: valid only if— (a) P is registered under this Act, and (b) the number is P's VAT registration number

elements.requirement: A VAT registration number means the number allocated by the Commissioners to a person registered under the Value Added Tax Act 1994.
elements.quote: “VAT registration number” means the number allocated by the Commissioners to a person registered under this Act

thresholds.what: period beginning with the day on which the operator is provided with the number within which a valid VAT registration number must be displayed
thresholds.quote: the end of the period of 10 days beginning with the day on which the operator is provided with the number

thresholds.what: relevant period beginning with the day the operator first became aware that the number was not valid within which an invalid number must be removed
thresholds.quote: the period of 10 days beginning with the day on which the operator first became aware that the number was not valid
